verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents all three pillars in one account. Spend is covered by corporate cards, expense controls and receipt capture. Bill pay is covered by invoice payments, approval flows, invoice scanning and vendor management. Banking is covered by multi-currency Jeeves Cash accounts with yield and FX. The vendor explicitly positions the product as one platform replacing a five-tool finance stack ('issue cards, pay bills, and earn up to 5%... all from one digital account'). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that it actually replaces existing point solutions, and evidence of onboarding or migration support for moving off incumbent tools.
